title: Surveys
subline: What was measured on site, by line. Each confirmed survey ADDS to the line's certified quantity, which caps a claim. Enter what this survey measured, not a running total; to change a mistaken survey use Correct.
emptyWho: The project manager, Finance or an Admin records a survey here; Finance or an Admin other than the recorder confirms it. A confirmed survey adds to the certified quantity, so enter each measurement once.
hintNotPermitted: Only the project manager, Finance or an Admin can record a survey.
hintNotIssued: Surveys are recorded while the work order is issued.
confirmBody: Confirming adds {{surveyed}} {{unit}} to the certified quantity of {{line}}. A confirmed survey cannot be edited; a mistake is fixed by recording a correction.
discardBody: The draft is removed from the list. It never counted towards the certified quantity.

form.attachmentsFailed: Survey saved, but some documents could not be attached.
form.qualityHelp: The part of the surveyed quantity that has quality documents. Attach them below.
form.peopleHelp: Anyone who took part, with or without an account: a customer representative, a supervisor, a surveyor.
form.name: Name
form.documentsHelp: Attach at least the survey sheet to confirm; add the quality documents for the quality-ready quantity. From this project's register: issued or approved, with a file.
form.noDocuments: No issued document with a file in the project register yet. Upload and issue the survey sheet there first; a survey cannot be confirmed without one.

errors.surveyed: Enter a quantity of 0 or more with at most 3 decimal places
errors.quality: Enter a quantity of 0 or more with at most 3 decimal places
errors.qualityOver: The quality-ready quantity cannot be more than the surveyed quantity
errors.person: Add at least one person, each with a name

form.surveyedHelp: Only what this survey measured. Each confirmed survey adds to the certified quantity; a mistaken one is changed with Correct.

refusal.generic: The survey could not be saved. Try again.
